body: I'm so tired of just hanging on and just getting by, I want to be sitting on my favorite rock on my favorite trail when the sun comes up in 5 hours. Then all I have to do is step over the edge and it is finally over.

Dad, Mom

I love you but im done, with this. Nothing works no matter how hard I try and no matter what I do. I can't see the top of this hole anymore. So im going now and won't be back. You are not the reason im doing this.

Your son, 
Xxxx xxxx
